reads.note: Vermont Ave (west face ~5275, east ~5350) ends at its north end on a narrow E-W alley (north line ~2372, south line ~2398) printed only 'ALLEY'; taken as Bates Alley by position (matches plate 22-38). Alley continues east toward the canal. A second unnamed alley at y~2800 inside the Cormany-Vermont block is not Bates.

Alley runs E-W between y~2372 (blue City of Cincinnati boundary) and block line y~2398. Vermont (50', x~5275-5350) ends at it from the south; a dashed (sewer/property) line at x~5333 continues north into the City of Cincinnati land, not a street. Identified as Bates Alley by position (north end of Vermont, one block above the middle avenue), the name is not printed.
